    name: "flow-meter-model"

  properties:
  - name: "flow_rate"

  - name: "flow_total"

          dataBits: 8
          parity: "none"
          stopBits: 1
        slaveID: 6
        visitors:
        - propertyName: "flow_rate"
          register: HoldingRegister
          offset: 9
          limit: 2
          scale: 0.01
          isSwap: false
          isRegisterSwap: false
        - propertyName: "flow_total"
          register: HoldingRegister
          offset: 12
          limit: 2
          scale: 0.01
          isSwap: false
          isRegisterSwap: false
